# Bianca's Beauty Shop

> Korean hair salon · 한국 미용실 based in Bloomington, Indiana. In Sook Avila takes your picture, your wild idea or your usual trim and gets it right, at a price regulars call reasonable. A Korean hair salon inside Annette's on S Pete Ellis Dr, by appointment Tuesday to Sunday.

- Phone: (812) 219-1146
- Based in: Bloomington, IN
- Nearby areas: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Nashville, Bedford, Martinsville, Spencer
- Google rating: 4.6 from 37 reviews

## Services
- Haircuts & trims: Trims, bobs and layered cuts, including the cuts for Asian hair clients say are hard to find in town.
- Vivid & fashion color: Purple, blue, teal, red: bright all-over color that comes out the shade you asked for.
- Peekaboo & split dye: A hidden pop of pink under a sleek bob, or half-and-half color for the brave.
- Ombre & soft color: Dark roots that melt into lighter, warmer ends, curled to show it off.
- Perms & straightening: Curls that hold and sleek, glossy straight hair.
- Updos & styling: Braided and twisted updos for weddings, dances and big days.

## About
Bianca's Beauty Shop is In Sook Avila's Korean hair salon (한국 미용실), in Suite 11 at Annette's, 223 S Pete Ellis Dr on the east side of Bloomington. Navy walls, warm oak stations and a chair that has seen a lot of color. Clients come for In Sook. Reviewers call her kind, detail-oriented and endlessly patient, game for any wild idea, and up on what teenagers actually want. Asian clients say she knows how to cut their hair when few stylists in town do, and one IU graduate still drives an hour and a half to see her. And many mention the same thing: great work for a reasonable price.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Call or text (812) 219-1146, or send a request from the booking page. Appointments are with In Sook.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Bianca's works by appointment, so call or text ahead and In Sook will find you a time.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Tuesday and Wednesday 10 AM to 6 PM, Thursday to Saturday 11 AM to 6 PM, and Sunday 12 to 6 PM. Closed Monday.
- Q: Where is the salon?
  A: Inside Annette's at 223 S Pete Ellis Dr, Suite 11, Bloomington, IN 47408, on the east side of town, a short drive from the IU campus.
- Q: Do you cut Asian hair?
  A: Yes. Asian clients say In Sook is the stylist in Bloomington who gets their hair right, and some have kept coming back for years.
- Q: Do you do vivid and fashion colors?
  A: Yes. Purple, blue, teal, pink peekaboos and split dye are all in the gallery, alongside ombre and natural shades.
- Q: Can I bring a picture of the look I want?
  A: Please do. One reviewer showed a photo of the cut she wanted and says it came out even better.
